execute.description: Block overlapping NORMAL bookings in the same room and date
execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."agendamento" ADD CONSTRAINT "agendamento_sem_sobreposicao_normal" EXCLUDE USING gist ("sala" WITH =, "data" WITH =, numrange((split_part("horaInicio", ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part("horaInicio", ':', 2)::int), (split_part("horaFim", ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part("horaFim", ':', 2)::int), '[)') WITH &&) WHERE ("prioridade" = 'NORMAL')
